slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that make your energy
impossible to ignore

morning swims

swim a few lengths before work once or twice a week. starting the day in cold water gives you a calm, awake energy that people notice the moment you walk in.

salsa classes

take a beginner salsa or swing class with complete strangers. moving to music with other people makes you looser, warmer and so much more fun to be around.

cooking for friends

host a simple, cosy dinner for a few friends once a month. people always remember the warm, generous energy of whoever gathers everyone around a table.

being curious

spend 5 minutes a day learning one fascinating thing: how bees talk, why the ocean glows. people light up around someone who's genuinely excited about ideas.

early runs

run three mornings a week before breakfast. the energy you build before anyone else is awake quietly carries into every single conversation you have that day.
